map.猜颜色是一款娱乐游戏领域的在线工具。娱乐游戏工具，纯前端实现，无需安装，离线可玩: Color Guessing is an online tool in the entertainment category. Pure front-end, no install, playable offline.
map.每轮随机生成 1 个目标色与 3 个干扰色共 4 个选项，用随机比较器打乱顺序后: Each round randomly generates 1 target color plus 3 distractor colors, 4 options in total, shuffled with a random comparator before rendering; options show uppercase hex values and a click compares against the target color; each round increments the round counter and correct answers add to the score; reset zeroes score and round and hides the swatches
map.色彩训练：看到随机色块，从 4 个十六进制选项中选出与色块完全一致的值。: Color training: see a random color swatch and pick the exactly matching hex value from 4 options.
map.每轮随机生成 1 个目标色与 3 个干扰色，共 4 个十六进制选项（顺序随机打乱: Each round randomly generates 1 target color and 3 distractors, 4 hex options in random order; clicking the option exactly matching the target scores 1 point over 10 rounds, and the result is shown as "score / 10" at the end.
map.目标色 #3CB371 与 3 个随机干扰色共 4 个选项 → 选中 #3CB3: Target color #3CB371 with 3 random distractors gives 4 options → selecting #3CB371 scores 1 point; answering 7 of 10 correctly gives 7/10 (70%). The better your color vision, the higher the accuracy.
map.本题为四选一：点击的十六进制值必须与目标色完全一致才判对，干扰色随机生成、通常差: This is a four-choice question: the clicked hex value must exactly match the target color, and the distractors are random and usually clearly different; the tool applies no color-difference tolerance.
